infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Health Buddy Agent uses the camera to photograph proof of delivery and your identity documents.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Health Buddy Agent uses the microphone only if you record a voice note on a job.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Health Buddy Agent asks for your photos so you can attach an identity document you have already saved.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Health Buddy Agent uses your location while you are carrying a delivery so the customer and the operations team can see where the parcel is. It is read only while a job is open and the app is on screen.
